primary_products.value: HVAC equipment; ultraviolet disinfection systems; pipe and cable locators; fare collection systems

primary_services.value: installation and maintenance services; engineering services

customer_segment.value: B2B: building owners, mechanical contractors, utilities, industrial operators; B2G: transit agencies, municipal utilities

end_markets.value: buildings and HVAC; utilities; transportation; water treatment; industrial

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: builds HVAC, UV, and detection products, sold to contractors, utilities, and transit agencies; service provider: installs and maintains equipment for building and utility customers
